visual_action: A montage of patriotic American moments, primarily from sports and military displays, plays in the background. The clips include fighter jets, Olympic athletes (gymnastics, track, wrestling, boxing), team sports (basketball, football, hockey), and large American flags being displayed. Superimposed over this montage is a cutout of the character Michael Scott from the TV show 'The Office'. He is shown plugging in a large speaker and then holding it up with a look of intense pride and excitement, as if he is the source of the patriotic music.

on_screen_text.text: Us for the next week until the 4th of July

spoken_summary: The video features the lyrics from the Toby Keith song "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue (The Angry American)": "My daddy served in the army... we lost his right eye but he flew a flag out in our yard 'til the day that he died. He wanted my mother, my brother, my sister and me to grow up and live..."
audio_music: A powerful and upbeat patriotic country song, "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue (The Angry American)" by Toby Keith, plays throughout the entire video, providing a high-energy and emotional soundtrack to the montage.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips, creating an energetic and celebratory mood.
manipulation_or_satire: The character Michael Scott from the TV show 'The Office' is digitally cut out from a scene and superimposed over the foreground of the entire video. He is shown holding a speaker, creating the humorous illusion that he is personally providing the patriotic soundtrack for the montage of events.
cultural_references: Michael Scott, a character from the sitcom 'The Office'
The meme format of superimposing Michael Scott with a speaker over videos to show enthusiastic approval
The song 'Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue (The Angry American)' by Toby Keith
central_claim: Americans get intensely and comically patriotic in the week leading up to the 4th of July.
intended_effect: To generate feelings of relatable, humorous, and celebratory patriotism in anticipation of the holiday.
uncertainty_flags: The provided authoritative face-ID lists Donald Trump, but he does not appear anywhere in the video.
